newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Uniwide 9-mth net up to 548.878 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Uniwide 9-mth net up to 548.878 mln pesos.

text.p: Philippine retail chain and property developer Uniwide Holdings Inc said on Monday its unaudited net income in the first nine months of the year reached 548.878 million pesos, including an extraordinary gain of 28.419 million pesos.
Uniwide posted net income of 80 million pesos in the three months from July to September 1995. It did not give figures for the period from October to December 1995.
The company began commercial operations in July 1995, a company official said.

The firm attributed the increase in its income from January to September this year to the revenue jump from the rentals of its warehouse-type malls, franchise fees from warehouse clubs and family stores and gains on the sales of commercial and residential lots.
